title: Cheaper checking step in agent-spec
item: Make the agent-spec Verify step (3 rounds of finders → verifiers → fix) faster and cheaper in tokens
motivation: The three rounds are slow and token-heavy (observed 2026-11-06)
done_means: The checking step runs on a lower-end model at medium effort, and no gated metric is worse than the baseline.
draft_note: Finish rule and low priority set by the owner 2026-11-15. E7 put the verifier on Sonnet in the old format and was reverted because it dropped real defects.
